sprint.name: Public Repo Cleanup & SQLite-Only
sprint.goal: Make the public repository safe and honest to hand to another club: no live credentials or author-specific server details in tracked files, the real reference deployment in git, no AGPL dependency in the shipped module, and SQLite declared (and coded) as the only supported database.
focus_areas: Remove credentials and author-server details from tracked docs
Bring the real production compose file and Caddyfile into git as the reference deployment
Keep the AGPL MuPDF dependency out of anything a club receives
SQLite is the only supported database - remove the untested Postgres path
